extra.message: Affected versions of org.springframework:spring-core are vulnerable to Improper Authorization / Incorrect Authorization. Spring's annotation resolution can fail on methods in type hierarchies with parameterized super-types and unbounded generics, causing annotations used for authorization (e.g. @PreAuthorize, @Secured, @Transactional) to be invisible on concrete implementations. In apps using Spring Security's @EnableMethodSecurity, security annotations declared on generic superclasses or interfaces may be ignored on subclasses, potentially allowing unauthorized access.

metadata.sca-reachable-if: you use method-security annotations like @PreAuthorize, @PostAuthorize, @Secured, @RolesAllowed that are placed only on methods in a generic interface or superclass with unbounded type parameters and the concrete implementations do not redeclare those annotations on the class or method

extra.message: Affected versions of com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind are vulnerable to Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference. Jackson-databind's XML DOM deserializer (`DOMDeserializer`) fails to fully disable external entity expansion on all XML providers. If an attacker supplies crafted XML and a provider that permits entity expansion (e.g. Xerces) is on the classpath, deserialization will resolve external entities, enabling XXE attacks that can compromise data integrity or leak sensitive information.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference
